_doc: 1.0.112 Aramaic speech rule groups (tools/aramaic-speech.mjs), per source of the post-pass (tools/aramaic-say-pass.mjs). A group is on for a source only if it passed the external review strictly above 9.5 there (verification/ARAMAIC-112.md, round 3): lav 10, zohar lexicon 9.8, suffix rules 9.7 (Bavli, Yerushalmi, prose), shva 9.8 (Yerushalmi, Onkelos). Off: shva in Bavli (9.3) and prose (9.2), the general lexicon (9.1).
